normalizedRequirement: Build a URL shortener service that creates short codes for long URLs, redirects a short code to its original URL with low latency under a read-heavy load, persists the mappings durably, and records click analytics that can be queried per link, all exposed through a documented REST API.
functionalRequirements: Create a short link from a long URL (POST), optionally with a custom alias
Redirect GET /{code} to the original URL with a 302 response
Return 404 for unknown codes, 400 for invalid URLs (http or https only, at most 2048 characters) and 409 for alias conflicts
Persist links durably so they survive a restart
Record a click event for every successful redirect without slowing the redirect down
Expose per-link analytics: total clicks, clicks per day and time of the last click
nonFunctionalRequirements: Read-heavy workload: assume 100 redirects for every link created
Redirect p99 latency under 50 ms when the mapping is cached
Availability target 99.9% for a single region; 99.999% would require multi-region active-active deployment and a replicated store
Analytics is best effort and asynchronous: it must never block or fail a redirect
Input validation to prevent open-redirect abuse through non-http schemes

ambiguities.question: Should users be able to choose custom aliases?
ambiguities.impact: Affects uniqueness handling, the API contract and abuse surface
ambiguities.assumedAnswer: Yes, optional. 3 to 32 characters from A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore and hyphen; a conflict returns 409

ambiguities.question: Do links expire or can they be deleted?
ambiguities.impact: Affects the schema, cache invalidation and analytics retention
ambiguities.assumedAnswer: Not in this iteration. Expiry is a planned follow-up enhancement

ambiguities.question: How detailed must analytics be, and may visitor IP addresses be stored?
ambiguities.assumedAnswer: Counts and daily aggregates only. No IP addresses, user agents or other personal data are stored

ambiguities.question: Is authentication required to create links or read analytics?
ambiguities.impact: Affects the API contract and abuse controls
ambiguities.assumedAnswer: No authentication in this iteration; API-key protection and rate limiting are documented follow-ups

assumptions: A single deployable service backed by one relational database
Short codes are 7 characters of base62, derived from a unique numeric id
Redirects use HTTP 302 so that clicks stay countable
outOfScope: A web UI for end users
